name: 音声の部屋で参加者の役割と保護を管理
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. ONE existing Lighthouse catalog component LH03-0006「音声の部屋で参加者の役割と保護を管理」.
Image hierarchy: ORIGINAL Image1 is PRIMARY for glyph geometry, proportions, optical stroke weight, alignment, fine control anatomy and meaningful action colors. Image2 our mock is SECONDARY for Japanese wording, logical390x808 layout and established typography. Do not copy its crude substitute icons or omissions. Image3 is approved style only.
Portrait UI component, about390:808 proportions, full component fills the image with modest white outer margin, no device frame or status bar. Preserve active participant-management action-sheet visible state and room/share context above. Pure white canvas, white rounded panels, subtle neutral borders, gentle downward shadows and restrained depth. No broad mint or gray-washed canvas. Background room context remains visible with quieter slate copy while the foreground white action sheet has clear elevation.
At top: original clean downward chevron on left; on right original small peace-hand emoji artwork and exact「静かに退出」in restrained destructive coral #C43D3D (exit, not primary green). Under it: small source-faithful two-person/friends outline glyph, exact「友だちの部屋」; original ellipsis at right (mock omitted this actual control). Heading next line「初めてのライブ」.
Then white lightly outlined shared-link preview with original external-link outline glyph at left and exact「ライトハウスの共有リンク」. Preserve original sharing context, no invented URL or photo. Below it small white outlined circle with forest-green「山」, then「山田 はるか が共有」. The catalog intentionally localized the person to an initial; retain that.
Foreground participant action sheet: header「佐藤 ゆう」quiet slate, then SIX centered, complete separate rows with thin neutral inset dividers:
ブロックする
部屋から退出してもらう
会話を妨げる行動を報告
問題が起きたことを報告
進行役にする
聞く側へ移動する
First FOUR labels in the same restrained coral #C43D3D, preserving original destructive/report grouping (our mock lost this). Last TWO forest green #1F6444, adapting the source blue role-management group coherently to Lighthouse. All ordinary supporting icons slate #526173. No random per-icon colors.
Separate bottom white neutral outlined rounded secondary button「キャンセル」, slate text; no green fill or primary styling on Cancel. No omitted rows, no added actions, badges, counts, labels or text.
Typography locked: Meiryo heading20px Bold/28px; action rows14px Regular/24px; category and leave12px Bold/16px; sharing text, target name, link title and Cancel12px Regular/16px; tracking0. Scale uniformly. Preserve full Japanese wording and use the mock's compact line wrapping/role proportions. Do not inflate every row or make all text bold.
Respect source controls' familiar fine geometry, preserve small peace-hand artwork colors, keep every Japanese glyph legible and all content unclipped. This is a static design candidate; do not suggest actual participant operations occurred.
reviewNotes: 原画像主参照により省略されていた退出絵文字・メニュー・外部リンク記号と4赤/2緑の操作意味を復元。出力を目視し日本語14項目と6操作を確認。しかし共有者アバターが禁止のミント塗り、友だち記号が原画像の微細形状を再現せずモック風の一般人物記号に留まる。要修正として直ちに保存登録。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。

inputReferences.role: primary ORIGINAL; participant action-sheet anatomy, glyphs, color semantics and missing controls
secondary mock; Japanese text and verified typography/logical arrangement
approved white surfaces, green brand depth and restraint only
